name: gym-gym
description: 纯本地的健身训练记录 PWA · 零后端零账号 · iPhone 添加到主屏幕即用 · A local-first gym tracker PWA (React + Zustand, no backend)

paragraphs: A local-first gym & body-weight tracker PWA — log every set, progressive overload built in, PRs detected automatically. Your data stays on your phone by default; optional self-hosted sync & push if you ever want it.
Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen → full-screen app → start training
features: 📅 Weekly plan / rotation: assign a routine to each weekday, or run a rotation (A → B → C → A) that follows whatever you actually did; Home shows today's session and, on rest days, when the next one is

📈 Progression engine: five auto-progression schemes per routine — linear, double progression, Greyskull LP (bonus for strong AMRAPs), triple progression (reps → sets → load) and time-based for planks/cardio; missed…
🗺️ Muscle map: an anatomical body map colors 18 regions by training load, recovery status, or neglect — spot your blind spots before they become imbalances
🧮 Plate math: barbell entries show the per-side plate breakdown for your bar and the plates you own
💪 RIR effort marking: optionally record reps-in-reserve per set (R0 = failure), shown in history

whatItDoes.text: A local-first gym & body-weight tracker PWA — log every set, progressive overload built in, PRs detected automatically. Your data stays on your phone by default; optional self-hosted sync & push if you ever want it.

requirements.text: 🔒 Local-first: no accounts, no third-party servers — the entire state is one JSON document in localStorage
🚫 With sync off, the app makes zero network requests: no analytics, no CDN calls, no accounts, no tracking
